rule_level_problems.problem: Single Urgent priority merges stroke, emergency and urgency criteria; emergency-only criteria (chest pain, CKD5, dyspnoea, severe HF) trigger at DBP 110-129 where the page's emergency rule needs DBP ≥130. Emergency vs urgency (refer urgently vs same day) not distinguished.
Overlapping: any emergency presentation with severe headache also fires urgency (same criteria, lower threshold), producing two probable diagnoses; page treats them as tiers.
'Weakness on 1 or both sides' encoded as generic Muscle weakness; 'Renal impairment' lacks eGFR<60 cut-off and eGFR <15 mapped to CKD5.
Hypertension grade diagnoses (mild/moderate/severe) from the flowchart not encoded.
check_for lists an item set that matches the Urgent rule; heart failure/orthopnea/leg swelling items consistent. No unused check_for items found.

summary: The red-box triage logic (stroke, hypertensive emergency, hypertensive urgency, heart failure rules plus check task and Urgent priority) is largely captured with the right BP thresholds. Most consequential problems: the single Urgent priority merges emergency and urgency criteria without distinguishing tiers, and hypertension grading diagnoses outside the box are unencoded. Minor concept looseness for weakness, eGFR thresholds.
